dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "I won't dismiss the class if you don't wake up."
dialogues.text: "I won't dismiss the class if you don't wake up."

dialogues.jp: 出席簿をもった暦先生が、俺を見下ろしている。
dialogues.en:
The teacher was looking down on me with her attendance book
in her hand.
dialogues.text:
The teacher was looking down on me with her attendance book
in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「授業だ。もう終わったけどな」
dialogues.en: "I was teaching the class. It's over now though."
dialogues.text: "I was teaching the class. It's over now though."

dialogues.jp: 出席簿片手に、暦先生が教壇に戻っていく。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei went back to the front with her attendance
book in her hand.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei went back to the front with her attendance
book in her hand.

dialogues.jp:
週番の号令を聞きながら、俺は｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺し
た……。

いつの間にか、２時限目の授業――終わってた
んだな……。
dialogues.en: The second class of the day...... was already over......
dialogues.text: The second class of the day...... was already over......

dialogues.jp:
俺が爆睡していたせいで、授業が終れないでい
たらしい。暦先生の出席簿の一撃で目を覚ます
と、授業が終った。
